title: Shopify responses change shape without a deploy because the pinned API version was retired and Shopify fell forward
symptoms: X-Shopify-API-Version response header shows a newer version than the one in the request URL
Fields or arguments that worked last quarter now return errors or null
cause: Each quarterly version stays accessible for about 12 months. After that, requests for it are served by the oldest version still supported, so breaking changes arrive on their own schedule.
fix: Read the X-Shopify-API-Version header on responses and webhooks, alert when it differs from what you pinned, and move the pin plus the shopify.app.toml webhooks api_version forward every quarter.
affected: All versioned Shopify APIs and webhooks; 2025-10 stops being accessible on 2026-10-16 15:00 UTC, 2026-01 on 2027-01-16
